newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Croesus says hard ore weighs on output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Croesus says hard ore weighs on output.

text.p: Croesus Mining NL said on Monday that the treatment of harder ore at its Binduli mine in Western Australia weighed on the December quarter gold yield.
Binduli produced 7,881 ounces of gold in the latest quarter, ended December 31, compared with 8,500 ounces in the previous quarter, Croesus said.
"Gold production was lower than forecast due to harder ore being enountered earlier in the Den Hur pit than predicted," the company said.

Hard oxide and sulphide ores were not suitable for crushing at the company's existing Hannan South plant and were being stockpiled at Binduli and would eventually be treated at a new mill, Croesus said.
Construction of a one-million-tonne-a-year ore treatment plant was scheduled to start this month, the company said.
The average gold price over the half year to December 31 due to gold hedging was A$604 an ounce, compared to A$483 an ounce on the spot market, Croesus said.
Forward sales were in place for a further 114,000 ounces at an average price of A$612 an ounce, it said.
Total resources at Binduli had increased to 757,000 ounces since June 3O, and included 375,000 ounces of ore reserves, the company said.
